title: Rapheni's Rebirth from Ashes now stacks
summary: Rapheni's Rebirth from Ashes buff changes from replacing itself to stacking up to two instances, on both of its rows. A New Year recharge gift table gains a fresh flag, a battle-report type table is introduced, and one soldier alert effect prefab is registered without exported art.
highlights: Rapheni: Rebirth from Ashes (both rows) now stacks with the existing instance, stacking parameter 0 → 2.
New Year recharge gift: fresh set to [3]; gift contents unchanged.
Effect prefab gfx_uicommon_soldier_alert_01 registered; no art exported for it yet.
